@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap');
:root{--ink:#20242a;--muted:#5f6874;--cream:#f7f5f0;--paper:#fff;--line:#e7e5df;--blue:#4266d5;--blue-dark:#3152b9;--green:#287b59}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif}.shell{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:68px 28px 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:72px}.intro{padding:18px 0}.brand-mark{width:45px;height:45px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;margin-bottom:54px;box-shadow:0 9px 22px #4266d546}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);margin:0 0 12px}.intro h1{font:700 clamp(42px,5vw,66px)/1.04 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 24px;letter-spacing:-1.5px}.intro h1 span{color:var(--blue)}.intro-copy{max-width:340px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.7}.intro-note{margin-top:54px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:#287b59;border-radius:50%}.panel{background:var(--paper);padding:38px 42px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 16px 50px #373d5010}.panel-heading,.section-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}.panel h2,.bookings-section h2{font:700 27px 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;margin:0}.calendar-icon{color:var(--blue);font-size:27px}.field{margin-top:22px}.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;color:#525a65}.field input,.field select{width:100%;height:47px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fcfcfb;padding:0 14px;font:14px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:.2s}.field input:focus,.field select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #4266d51a}.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.primary-button{border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;width:100%;height:50px;margin-top:20px;font:700 14px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.primary-button:hover{background:var(--blue-dark)}.primary-button span{font-size:20px;margin-left:8px}.form-error{color:#b63d3d;font-size:12px;min-height:16px;margin:14px 0 0}.bookings-section{grid-column:1/-1}.section-heading{align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:19px}.count{background:#e4e9fb;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 12px}.booking-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed #d5d5cf;border-radius:12px}.empty-state span{font-size:28px;color:#586273}.empty-state p{margin:9px 0 3px;font-weight:700;color:#626a76}.empty-state small{font-size:12px}.confirmation{display:none;margin-top:18px;background:#e9f6ef;color:var(--green);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.confirmation.show{display:block}.booking-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:19px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px}.booking-card.cancelled{opacity:.65}.booking-card.cancelled .booking-name{text-decoration:line-through}.booking-name{font-weight:700;margin:0 0 7px}.booking-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.booking-type{font-size:12px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}.cancel-button{background:transparent;border:1px solid #e1bcbc;color:#ae5353;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px;font:600 12px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.cancel-button:hover{background:#fff3f3}.status-label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:#ae5353;font-weight:700}@media(max-width:760px){.shell{display:block;padding:35px 18px 60px}.intro{padding:0 4px 38px}.brand-mark{margin-bottom:32px}.intro-note{margin-top:28px}.panel{padding:27px 21px}.bookings-section{margin-top:45px}.booking-card{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.cancel-button{align-self:flex-end}.form-row{gap:10px}}

:root{--ink:#202b38;--muted:#72808d;--line:#e5e9ec;--cream:#f8f7f3;--blue:#2264e5;--soft:#eef4ff;--green:#e7f6ed}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);max-width:510px;margin:0}.hero-note{margin-top:24px;color:#66737e;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.note-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;background:#42b878;border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px}.content-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}.panel{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(39,55,70,.045);padding:32px}.panel-heading,.list-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:28px}h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:28px;margin:8px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.5px}.calendar-mark{background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue);font-size:24px;border-radius:10px;width:43px;height:43px;text-align:center;padding-top:7px}.field{margin-bottom:19px}.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;color:#475461}input,select{width:100%;height:46px;border:1px solid #d8dfe4;border-radius:7px;padding:0 13px;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;outline:none;transition:.2s}input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #eaf1ff}input::placeholder{color:#a2adb5}.two-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.primary-button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:7px;height:49px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font:700 14px 'DM Sans';cursor:pointer;margin-top:7px;transition:.2s}.primary-button:hover{background:#174fbe;transform:translateY(-1px)}.primary-button span{font-size:20px;vertical-align:-1px;margin-left:8px}.count-badge{background:var(--soft);color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 11px}.booking-list{min-height:255px}.empty-state{min-height:250px;border:1px dashed #dce3e8;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;color:var(--muted);gap:8px;text-align:center}.empty-state strong{color:var(--ink);font-size:14px}.empty-state span{font-size:12px}.empty-icon{font-size:34px;color:#adc0d5;margin-bottom:3px}.booking-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--blue);border-radius:8px;padding:17px 16px;margin-bottom:12px;position:relative}.booking-card.cancelled{border-left-color:#aeb8bf;opacity:.7}.booking-card.cancelled .booking-person{text-decoration:line-through}.booking-person{font-weight:700;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:7px}.booking-meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}.booking-type{color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}.cancel-button{position:absolute;right:13px;top:14px;border:0;background:none;color:#9a5b62;font:600 11px 'DM Sans';cursor:pointer}.cancel-button:hover{text-decoration:underline}.cancelled-label{position:absolute;right:13px;top:14px;color:#7e898f;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}.confirmation{margin-top:18px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--green);color:#267044;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.confirmation[hidden]{display:none}footer{text-align:center;color:#a4adb4;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:30px}footer span{color:var(--blue);padding:0 7px}@media(max-width:760px){.page-shell{padding:42px 18px application.javascript: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){const form=document.getElementById('booking-form');const list=document.getElementById('booking-list');const empty=document.getElementById('empty-state');const confirmation=document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-confirmation"]');const count=document.getElementById('booking-count');const dateInput=document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-date"]');const today=new Date();today.setMinutes(today.getMinutes()-today.getTimezoneOffset());dateInput.min=today.toISOString().slice(0,10);let bookings=[];function render(){empty.hidden=bookings.length>0;list.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="booking"]').forEach(function(el){el.remove()});bookings.forEach(function(item){const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='booking-card'+(item.cancelled?' cancelled':'');card.dataset.testid='booking';card.dataset.status=item.cancelled?'cancelled':'active';const person=document.createElement('div');person.className='booking-person';person.dataset.testid='booking-name-display';person.textContent=item.name;const type=document.createElement('div');type.className='booking-type';type.textContent=item.type;const meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='booking-meta';meta.textContent=formatDate(item.date)+' · '+formatTime(item.time)+'\n'+item.email;card.append(person,type,meta);if(item.cancelled){const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='cancelled-label';label.textContent='Cancelled';card.appendChild(label)}else{const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='cancel-button';button.dataset.testid='booking-cancel';button.type='button';button.textContent='Cancel';button.addEventListener('click',function(){item.cancelled=true;render()});card.appendChild(button)}list.appendChild(card)});count.textContent=bookings.filter(function(b){return !b.cancelled}).length}function formatDate(value){return new Date(value+'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'})}function formatTime(value){const parts=value.split(':');const d=new Date();d.setHours(parts[0],parts[1]);return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})}form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();if(!form.checkValidity()){form.reportValidity();return}if(dateInput.value<dateInput.min){dateInput.setCustomValidity('Please choose today or a future date.');form.reportValidity();dateInput.setCustomValidity('');return}const data=new FormData(form);bookings.push({name:data.get('name')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-name"]').value,email:data.get('email')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-email"]').value,date:data.get('date')||dateInput.value,time:data.get('time')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-time"]').value,type:data.get('type')||document.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-type"]').value,cancelled:false});render();confirmation.textContent='Appointment confirmed — we look forward to seeing you, '+bookings[bookings.length-1].name+'!';confirmation.hidden=false;form.reset();dateInput.min=today.toISOString().slice(0,10)});render()});

application.javascript:
const form=document.getElementById('booking-form');const dateInput=document.getElementById('date');const list=document.getElementById('booking-list');const empty=document.getElementById('empty-state');const error=document.getElementById('form-error');const confirmation=document.getElementById('confirmation');const count=document.getElementById('booking-count');const bookings=[];const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const today=new Date();dateInput.min=`${today.getFullYear()}-${pad(today.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(today.getDate())}`;function displayDate(value){return new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'short',month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'})}function displayTime(value){const [h,m]=value.split(':');const d=new Date();d.setHours(h,m);return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})}function render(){empty.hidden=bookings.length>0;count.textContent=bookings.filter(b=>!b.cancelled).length;list.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="booking"]').forEach(node=>node.remove());bookings.forEach((booking,index)=>{const article=document.createElement('article');article.className=`booking${booking.cancelled?' cancelled':''}`;article.dataset.testid='booking';article.dataset.status=booking.cancelled?'cancelled':'active';article.innerHTML=`

${booking.type}
${booking.cancelled?'Cancelled':'Confirmed'}
▣ ${displayDate(booking.date)}◷ ${displayTime(booking.time)}✉ ${booking.email}
${booking.cancelled?'':''}`;article.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-name-display"]').textContent=booking.name;if(!booking.cancelled)article.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-cancel"]').addEventListener('click',()=>{booking.cancelled=true;render()});list.appendChild(article)})}form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();error.textContent='';if(!form.checkValidity()){form.reportValidity();return}const data=new FormData(form);const selected=data.get('date');const chosen=new Date(`${selected}T00:00:00`);const now=new Date();now.setHours(0,0,0,0);if(chosen{confirmation.hidden=true},5000)});render();

:root{--ink:#172126;--muted:#536267;--line:#dfe7e5;--mint:#bdf3d5;--teal:#167c70;--paper:#fbfdfc}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:#eaf5f0;color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:42px 18px}.quiz-shell{width:min(820px,100%)}.hero{margin-bottom:27px}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:#f5a67e;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}.hero h1{font:700 clamp(34px,6vw,55px)/1.05 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0 0 13px}.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}.quiz-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(39,102,87,.12);border-radius:18px;padding:31px 38px 26px;box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(38,93,76,.11)}.card-topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:24px;margin-bottom:5px}.card-topline h2{font:600 23px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;margin:0 0 5px}.instruction{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.question-count{font:700 21px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--teal);text-align:right}.question-count small{display:block;color:#526560;font:700 9px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-top:2px}.question{border:0;padding:23px 0 24px;margin:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}legend{padding:0;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;font:600 16px/1.4 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}.number{color:#627570;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;padding-top:3px}.options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:17px 0 0 32px}.option{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 13px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s ease;background:#fff}.option:hover{border-color:#7bcbb1;background:#f2fbf6}.option input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.radio{width:15px;height:15px;border:1.5px solid #61726e;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center}.option input:checked~.radio{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px white}.option:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--teal);background:#edfaf3;color:#12695e}.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:25px;gap:20px}button{border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--teal);color:white;font:700 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;padding:14px 21px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(22,124,112,.2);transition:.2s}button:hover{background:#10665c;transform:translateY(-1px)}button span{font-size:19px;margin-left:13px;vertical-align:-1px}.result{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px}.result-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:5px}.result strong{font:700 30px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--teal)}.out-of{font-size:13px;color:#526560}.message{min-height:18px;text-align:right;color:#9b5038;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 0}footer{text-align:center;color:#536b64;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.6px;margin-top:22px}footer span{color:#b45c3f;margin:0 6px}@media(max-width:620px){body{padding:28px 13px}.quiz-card{padding:24px 20px}.options{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-left:29px}.actions{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.result{align-self:flex-end}.hero h1{letter-spacing:-1.5px}}
